#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Generates docs/openapi/clockify-openapi.yaml from the repo-local Clockify API
# evidence bundle. The script is intentionally self-contained because the
# source bundle includes a mix of valid OpenAPI YAML, pasted Markdown API docs,
# live probe findings, and QA reports.

require "date"
require "digest"
require "fileutils"
require "json"
require "optparse"
require "set"
require "yaml"

Encoding.default_external = Encoding::UTF_8
Encoding.default_internal = Encoding::UTF_8

METHODS = %w[get post put patch delete options head trace].freeze
METHOD_ORDER = {
  "get" => 0,
  "post" => 1,
  "put" => 2,
  "patch" => 3,
  "delete" => 4,
  "options" => 5,
  "head" => 6,
  "trace" => 7
}.freeze

DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT = File.expand_path("..", __dir__)
DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT = File.join(DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT, "docs/openapi/sources")
DEFAULT_REAL_DIR = File.join(DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT, "realOPENAPI")
DEFAULT_PROBE_DIR = File.join(DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT, "clockify-api-probe-lab")
DEFAULT_AIII_OPENAPI = File.join(DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT, "AIII/openapi.yaml")
DEFAULT_OUT = File.join(DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT, "docs/openapi/clockify-openapi.yaml")

MAIN_SERVER = "https://api.clockify.me/api/v1"
REPORTS_SERVER = "https://reports.api.clockify.me/v1"
AUDIT_LOG_SERVER = "https://auditlog-api.api.clockify.me/v1"

SOURCE_PRIORITIES = {
  "real-openapi" => 40,
  "probe-openapi" => 30,
  "probe-supplement" => 25,
  "probe-fragment" => 20,
  "aiii-openapi" => 15,
  "doc-md" => 10
}.freeze
CORE_ENTITY_REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
  "Tag" => %w[id name workspaceId archived],
  "Client" => %w[id name workspaceId archived],
  "Project" => %w[id name workspaceId billable color archived public template],
  "Task" => %w[id name projectId status billable],
  "UserDtoV1" => %w[id email name status],
  "TimeEntry" => %w[id description userId billable workspaceId timeInterval type isLocked]
}.freeze
SENSITIVE_EXAMPLE_KEY_RE = /\A(?:api[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|token|secret)\z/i
EMAIL_EXAMPLE_RE = /\b[A-Z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b/i

options = {
  real_dir: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_REAL_DIR", DEFAULT_REAL_DIR),
  probe_dir: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_PROBE_DIR", DEFAULT_PROBE_DIR),
  findings_dir: ENV["CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_FINDINGS_DIR"],
  aiii_openapi: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_AIII_FILE", DEFAULT_AIII_OPENAPI),
  repo_root: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_REPO_ROOT", DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT),
  out: DEFAULT_OUT,
  validate_only: false
}

OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = "Usage: scripts/gen-clockify-openapi [options]"
  opts.on("-out PATH", "--out PATH", "Output YAML path") { |v| options[:out] = v }
  opts.on("--real-dir PATH", "realOPENAPI source directory") { |v| options[:real_dir] = v }
  opts.on("--probe-dir PATH", "clockify-api-probe-lab directory") { |v| options[:probe_dir] = v }
  opts.on("--findings-dir PATH", "QA findings directory") { |v| options[:findings_dir] = v }
  opts.on("--aiii-openapi PATH", "additional official-style OpenAPI export") { |v| options[:aiii_openapi] = v }
  opts.on("--repo-root PATH", "GOCLMCP repo root") { |v| options[:repo_root] = v }
  opts.on("--validate-only", "Validate an existing generated YAML") { options[:validate_only] = true }
end.parse!

def deep_copy(value)
  JSON.parse(JSON.generate(value))
end

def canonical_json(value)
  JSON.generate(sort_deep(value))
end

def sort_deep(value)
  case value
  when Hash
    value.keys.map(&:to_s).sort.each_with_object({}) do |key, out|
      out[key] = sort_deep(value[key])
    end
  when Array
    value.map { |item| sort_deep(item) }
  else
    value
  end
end

def redact_sensitive_examples!(value)
  case value
  when Hash
    value.each do |key, child|
      if child.is_a?(String) && key.to_s.match?(SENSITIVE_EXAMPLE_KEY_RE)
        value[key] = "<redacted>"
      elsif child.is_a?(String)
        value[key] = child.gsub(EMAIL_EXAMPLE_RE, "<EMAIL>")
      else
        redact_sensitive_examples!(child)
      end
    end
  when Array
    value.each_with_index do |child, index|
      if child.is_a?(String) && !value.frozen?
        value[index] = child.gsub(EMAIL_EXAMPLE_RE, "<EMAIL>")
      else
        redact_sensitive_examples!(child)
      end
    end
  end
end

def yaml_files(dir)
  return [] unless Dir.exist?(dir)

  Dir[File.join(dir, "*")].select { |path| path.match?(/\.(ya?ml)\z/i) }.sort
end

def load_yaml_file(path)
  YAML.load_file(path, aliases: true, permitted_classes: [Date, Time])
rescue ArgumentError
  YAML.load_file(path)
end

def source_manifest(root)
  path = File.join(root, "manifest.json")
  return nil unless File.exist?(path)

  manifest = JSON.parse(File.read(path))
  digest = Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest
  [path, manifest, digest]
end

def validate_source_manifest!(root)
  payload = source_manifest(root)
  return nil unless payload

  path, manifest, digest = payload
  errors = []
  Array(manifest["files"]).each do |entry|
    rel = entry["path"].to_s
    if rel.empty? || rel.start_with?("/") || rel.split("/").include?("..")
      errors << "invalid source manifest path #{rel.inspect}"
      next
    end
    file = File.join(root, rel)
    unless File.file?(file)
      errors << "source manifest missing #{rel}"
      next
    end
    size = File.size(file)
    sha = Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest
    errors << "source manifest size mismatch #{rel}" if entry["bytes"].to_i != size
    errors << "source manifest sha256 mismatch #{rel}" if entry["sha256"].to_s != sha
  end

  # Completeness (reverse) check: every consumed openapi fragment on disk must be
  # pinned in the manifest. The forward loop above only verifies LISTED files; it
  # never asserts that every consumed input is listed, so a new/edited fragment
  # could otherwise slip in unhashed (e.g. audit-log.yaml did). These globs mirror
  # the generator's own probe-fragment globs below.
  pinned = Array(manifest["files"]).map { |entry| entry["path"].to_s }
  ["clockify-api-probe-lab/openapi-fragments", "clockify-api-probe-lab/openapi-fragments-v3"].each do |dir|
    Dir[File.join(root, dir, "*.yaml")].sort.each do |abs|
      rel = abs.sub(%r{\A#{Regexp.escape(root)}/?}, "")
      errors << "source consumed but not pinned in manifest: #{rel}" unless pinned.include?(rel)
    end
  end
  abort(errors.join("\n")) unless errors.empty?

  {
    "path" => path.sub(%r{\A#{Regexp.escape(root)}/?}, ""),
    "sha256" => digest,
    "files" => Array(manifest["files"]).size
  }
end

def source_label(path, options)
  expanded = File.expand_path(path)
  roots = {
    "realOPENAPI" => File.expand_path(options[:real_dir]),
    "clockify-api-probe-lab" => File.expand_path(options[:probe_dir]),
    "AIII" => File.dirname(File.expand_path(options[:aiii_openapi])),
    "GOCLMCP" => File.expand_path(options[:repo_root])
  }
  roots["qa-findings"] = File.expand_path(options[:findings_dir]) if options[:findings_dir].to_s != ""
  root_name, root_path = roots.find { |_name, root| expanded.start_with?(root + File::SEPARATOR) || expanded == root }
  return expanded unless root_name

  rel = expanded.sub(root_path, "").sub(%r{\A/}, "")
  rel.empty? ? root_name : File.join(root_name, rel)
end

def domain_from_path(path)
  base = File.basename(path).downcase
  return "reports" if base.include?("attendance") || base.include?("report")
  return "approval" if base.include?("approval")
  return "balance" if base.include?("balance")
  return "custom_fields" if base.include?("cf") || base.include?("custom")
  return "expenses" if base.include?("expense")
  return "holidays" if base.include?("holiday")
  return "invoices" if base.include?("invoice") || base.include?("inveoice")
  return "policies" if base.include?("polic")
  return "projects" if base.include?("project")
  return "scheduling" if base.include?("schedul")
  return "tasks" if base.include?("task")
  return "time_entries" if base.include?("timeentr")
  return "time_off" if base.include?("timeoff") || base.include?("time-off")
  return "user_groups" if base.include?("group")
  return "users" if base.include?("user")
  return "webhooks" if base.include?("webhook")
  return "workspaces" if base.include?("workspace")
  return "clients" if base.include?("client")
  return "tags" if base.include?("tag")

  File.basename(path, File.extname(path)).downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, "_")
end

def pascal_domain(domain)
  domain.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).reject(&:empty?).map { |part| part[0].upcase + part[1..] }.join
end

def normalize_path(path)
  normalized = path.to_s.strip
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://auditlog-api\.api\.clockify\.me/api/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://auditlog-api\.api\.clockify\.me/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://api\.clockify\.me/api/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://reports\.api\.clockify\.me/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://api\.clockify\.me/api}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://reports\.api\.clockify\.me}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\A/api/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\A/v1}, "")
  normalized = "/" + normalized unless normalized.start_with?("/")
  canonicalize_path_params(normalized.gsub(%r{/+}, "/"))
end

def canonicalize_path_params(path)
  segments = path.split("/")
  segments.each_with_index do |segment, i|
    next unless segment.match?(/\A\{[^}]+\}\z/)

    raw_name = segment[1..-2]
    previous = segments[i - 1].to_s
    canonical = case raw_name
                when "ws", "wsId", "workspace", "workspace_id", "workspaceId"
                  "workspaceId"
                when "uid", "user", "user_id", "userId"
                  "userId"
                else
                  canonical_param_for_segment(previous, raw_name)
                end
    segments[i] = "{#{canonical}}"
  end
  out = segments.join("/")
  out.empty? ? "/" : out
end

def canonical_param_for_segment(segment, fallback)
  {
    "addons" => "addonId",
    "approval-requests" => "approvalRequestId",
    "assignments" => "assignmentId",
    "categories" => "categoryId",
    "clients" => "clientId",
    "custom-fields" => "customFieldId",
    "expenses" => "expenseId",
    "holidays" => "holidayId",
    "invoices" => "invoiceId",
    "items" => "order",
    "payments" => "paymentId",
    "policies" => "policyId",
    "projects" => "projectId",
    "requests" => "requestId",
    "shared-reports" => "sharedReportId",
    "tags" => "tagId",
    "tasks" => "taskId",
    "time-entries" => "timeEntryId",
    "user" => "userId",
    "user-groups" => "groupId",
    "users" => "userId",
    "webhooks" => "webhookId"
  }.fetch(segment, fallback)
end

def host_for(path, op = nil, source_servers = [])
  text = [path, op&.fetch("description", nil), op&.fetch("summary", nil)].compact.join(" ").downcase
  operation_servers = Array(op && op["servers"]).map { |server| server["url"].to_s }
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if operation_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") }
  return REPORTS_SERVER if operation_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("reports.api.clockify.me") } &&
                           operation_servers.none? { |url| url.include?("api.clockify.me/api") }
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if source_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") }
  return REPORTS_SERVER if source_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("reports.api.clockify.me") } &&
                           source_servers.none? { |url| url.include?("api.clockify.me/api") }
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if text.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") || text.include?("/audit-log")
  return REPORTS_SERVER if text.include?("/reports/") || text.include?("shared-reports")

  MAIN_SERVER
end

def normalize_security!(value, aliases)
  case value
  when Hash
    value.keys.each do |key|
      new_key = case key.to_s
                when "AddonKeyAuth", "MarketplaceKeyAuth"
                  aliases << key.to_s
                  "AddonTokenAuth"
                when "ApiKeyAuth"
                  "ApiKeyAuth"
                else
                  key
                end
      child = value.delete(key)
      value[new_key] = child
      normalize_security!(child, aliases)
    end
  when Array
    value.each { |item| normalize_security!(item, aliases) }
  end
end

def canonical_security_scheme(name)
  case name.to_s
  when "AddonKeyAuth", "MarketplaceKeyAuth", "AddonTokenAuth"
    "AddonTokenAuth"
  when "ApiKeyAuth"
    "ApiKeyAuth"
  else
    name.to_s
  end
end

def operation_security_aliases(op, schemes)
  aliases = Hash.new { |h, key| h[key] = {"schemes" => Set.new, "headers" => Set.new} }
  Array(op["security"]).each do |requirement|
    next unless requirement.is_a?(Hash)

    requirement.keys.each do |scheme|
      canonical = canonical_security_scheme(scheme)
      aliases[canonical]["schemes"] << scheme.to_s
      header = schemes.dig(scheme, "name").to_s if schemes.is_a?(Hash)
      aliases[canonical]["headers"] << header unless header.to_s.empty?
    end
  end
  aliases.keys.sort.each_with_object({}) do |scheme, out|
    out[scheme] = {
      "schemes" => aliases[scheme]["schemes"].to_a.sort,
      "headers" => aliases[scheme]["headers"].to_a.sort
    }
  end
end

def rewrite_refs!(value, ref_maps)
  case value
  when Hash
    if value["$ref"].is_a?(String)
      value["$ref"] = rewrite_ref(value["$ref"], ref_maps)
    end
    value.each_value { |child| rewrite_refs!(child, ref_maps) }
  when Array
    value.each { |child| rewrite_refs!(child, ref_maps) }
  end
end

def rewrite_ref(ref, ref_maps)
  match = ref.match(%r{\A#/components/([^/]+)/([^/]+)\z})
  return ref unless match

  section = match[1]
  name = match[2]
  mapped = ref_maps.dig(section, name)
  mapped ? "#/components/#{section}/#{mapped}" : ref
end

def operation_id(method, path, used)
  raw = "#{method}_#{path}"
        .gsub(/[{}]/, "")
        .gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/, "_")
        .gsub(/\A_+|_+\z/, "")
  parts = raw.split("_").reject(&:empty?)
  id = parts.first.to_s.downcase + parts.drop(1).map { |part| part[0].upcase + part[1..] }.join
  id = "#{method}Operation" if id.empty?
  unique = id
  suffix = 2
  while used.include?(unique)
    unique = "#{id}#{suffix}"
    suffix += 1
  end
  used << unique
  unique
end

def method_path_from_doc(lines)
  operations = []
  pending_method = nil
  lines.each do |line|
    stripped = line.strip
    if stripped.match?(/\A(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\z/i)
      pending_method = stripped.downcase
      next
    end
    inline = stripped.match(/\A(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\s+(\/(?:api\/)?v1\/\S+)/i)
    if inline
      operations << [inline[1].downcase, normalize_path(inline[2])]
      pending_method = nil
      next
    end
    next unless pending_method && stripped.match?(%r{\A/(?:api/)?v1/})

    path = stripped.split(/\s+/).first
    operations << [pending_method, normalize_path(path)]
    pending_method = nil
  end
  operations.uniq
end

def extract_status(raw)
  token = raw.to_s[/\b([1-5][0-9][0-9])\b/, 1]
  token&.to_i
end

def pending_live_finding_row?(text)
  text.to_s.match?(/\bTODO-live\b/i)
end

def status_bucket(status, text)
  lowered = text.to_s.downcase
  return "live-success" if status && status >= 200 && status < 300
  # 405 means the path EXISTS and the verb does not. Clockify returns
  # code:3000 for this as well as for an absent path, so bucket 405
  # separately before the absent-path test below; otherwise a live route
  # documented under the wrong verb reads as a phantom and invites a
  # wrong PHANTOM_PATHS entry. The distinguishing wire signal is the
  # `allow` response header, which lists the verbs the path does serve.
  return "method-not-allowed" if status == 405
  # 4xx with the "No static resource" upstream message means the path
  # itself does not exist. Match the MESSAGE, not the bare code:3000,
  # which Clockify reuses for wrong-verb responses. Treat as fully
  # unsupported / phantom so callers can decide to quarantine the path.
  # The /cap/ keyword used to match /scheduling/capacity by accident —
  # narrow it to whole words.
  return "unsupported" if status && [400, 404, 409, 415, 422].include?(status) &&
                          lowered.match?(/no static resource/)
  return "workspace-state-limited" if lowered.match?(/archive|active|workspace-state|in-use|\bcap-skipped\b|\bcap\s|\blimit\b/)
  return "permission-gated" if lowered.match?(/permission|plan|membership|owner|forbidden|not allowed|requires/)
  return "unsupported" if status && [400, 404, 405, 409, 415, 422].include?(status)
  return "documented" unless status

  "live-validated-error"
end

def phantom_path?(method, path)
  PHANTOM_PATHS.include?([method.downcase, path])
end

def host_from_source(value)
  text = value.to_s.downcase
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if text.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me")
  return REPORTS_SERVER if text.include?("reports.api.clockify.me")
  return MAIN_SERVER if text.include?("api.clockify.me")

  nil
end

def server_from_finding(host_value, path_value)
  host_text = host_value.to_s.downcase
  path_text = path_value.to_s.downcase
  text = "#{host_text} #{path_text}"
  return "https://auditlog-api.api.clockify.me/api/v1" if text.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") && path_text.match?(%r{(^|/)api/v1/})
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if text.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me")
  reports = text.include?("reports.api.clockify.me")
  main = text.include?("api.clockify.me") && !reports
  return "https://reports.api.clockify.me/api/v1" if reports && path_text.match?(%r{(^|/)api/v1/})
  return REPORTS_SERVER if reports
  return "https://api.clockify.me/v1" if main && path_text.match?(%r{(^|/)v1/}) && !path_text.match?(%r{(^|/)api/v1/})
  return MAIN_SERVER if main

  nil
end

      cells = line.split("|").map(&:strip)

      method = nil
      path = nil
      status = nil
      host = nil
      if METHODS.include?(cells[1].to_s.downcase) && cells[3].to_s.include?("/")
        method = cells[1].downcase
        path = normalize_path(cells[3])
        host = server_from_finding(cells[2], cells[3]) || host_from_source(cells[2]) || host_from_source(cells[3])
        status = extract_status(cells[4])
      elsif METHODS.include?(cells[3].to_s.downcase) && cells[2].to_s.include?("/")
        method = cells[3].downcase
        path = normalize_path(cells[2])
        host = server_from_finding(cells[1], cells[2]) || host_from_source(cells[1]) || host_from_source(cells[2])
        status = extract_status(cells[4])
      elsif cells[1].to_s.include?("/") && METHODS.include?(cells[2].to_s.downcase)
        method = cells[2].downcase
        path = normalize_path(cells[1])
        host = server_from_finding(cells[1], cells[1]) || host_from_source(cells[1])

      end

      text = line

        "source" => label,
        "host" => host,
        "status" => status,
        "bucket" => status_bucket(status, text),
        "note" => text.gsub(/\s+/, " ")[0, 240]
      }
    end
  end
  records
end

#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Generates docs/openapi/clockify-openapi.yaml from the repo-local Clockify API
# evidence bundle. The script is intentionally self-contained because the
# source bundle includes a mix of valid OpenAPI YAML, pasted Markdown API docs,
# live probe findings, and QA reports.

require "date"
require "digest"
require "fileutils"
require "json"
require "optparse"
require "set"
require "yaml"

Encoding.default_external = Encoding::UTF_8
Encoding.default_internal = Encoding::UTF_8

METHODS = %w[get post put patch delete options head trace].freeze
METHOD_ORDER = {
  "get" => 0,
  "post" => 1,
  "put" => 2,
  "patch" => 3,
  "delete" => 4,
  "options" => 5,
  "head" => 6,
  "trace" => 7
}.freeze

DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT = File.expand_path("..", __dir__)
DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT = File.join(DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT, "docs/openapi/sources")
DEFAULT_REAL_DIR = File.join(DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT, "realOPENAPI")
DEFAULT_PROBE_DIR = File.join(DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT, "clockify-api-probe-lab")
DEFAULT_AIII_OPENAPI = File.join(DEFAULT_SOURCE_ROOT, "AIII/openapi.yaml")
DEFAULT_OUT = File.join(DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT, "docs/openapi/clockify-openapi.yaml")

MAIN_SERVER = "https://api.clockify.me/api/v1"
REPORTS_SERVER = "https://reports.api.clockify.me/v1"
AUDIT_LOG_SERVER = "https://auditlog-api.api.clockify.me/v1"

SOURCE_PRIORITIES = {
  "real-openapi" => 40,
  "probe-openapi" => 30,
  "probe-supplement" => 25,
  "probe-fragment" => 20,
  "aiii-openapi" => 15,
  "doc-md" => 10
}.freeze
CORE_ENTITY_REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
  "Tag" => %w[id name workspaceId archived],
  "Client" => %w[id name workspaceId archived],
  "Project" => %w[id name workspaceId billable color archived public template],
  "Task" => %w[id name projectId status billable],
  "UserDtoV1" => %w[id email name status],
  "TimeEntry" => %w[id description userId billable workspaceId timeInterval type isLocked]
}.freeze
SENSITIVE_EXAMPLE_KEY_RE = /\A(?:api[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|token|secret)\z/i
EMAIL_EXAMPLE_RE = /\b[A-Z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b/i

options = {
  real_dir: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_REAL_DIR", DEFAULT_REAL_DIR),
  probe_dir: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_PROBE_DIR", DEFAULT_PROBE_DIR),
  findings_dir: ENV["CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_FINDINGS_DIR"],
  aiii_openapi: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_AIII_FILE", DEFAULT_AIII_OPENAPI),
  repo_root: ENV.fetch("CLOCKIFY_OPENAPI_REPO_ROOT", DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT),
  out: DEFAULT_OUT,
  validate_only: false
}

OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = "Usage: scripts/gen-clockify-openapi [options]"
  opts.on("-out PATH", "--out PATH", "Output YAML path") { |v| options[:out] = v }
  opts.on("--real-dir PATH", "realOPENAPI source directory") { |v| options[:real_dir] = v }
  opts.on("--probe-dir PATH", "clockify-api-probe-lab directory") { |v| options[:probe_dir] = v }
  opts.on("--findings-dir PATH", "QA findings directory") { |v| options[:findings_dir] = v }
  opts.on("--aiii-openapi PATH", "additional official-style OpenAPI export") { |v| options[:aiii_openapi] = v }
  opts.on("--repo-root PATH", "GOCLMCP repo root") { |v| options[:repo_root] = v }
  opts.on("--validate-only", "Validate an existing generated YAML") { options[:validate_only] = true }
end.parse!

def deep_copy(value)
  JSON.parse(JSON.generate(value))
end

def canonical_json(value)
  JSON.generate(sort_deep(value))
end

def sort_deep(value)
  case value
  when Hash
    value.keys.map(&:to_s).sort.each_with_object({}) do |key, out|
      out[key] = sort_deep(value[key])
    end
  when Array
    value.map { |item| sort_deep(item) }
  else
    value
  end
end

def redact_sensitive_examples!(value)
  case value
  when Hash
    value.each do |key, child|
      if child.is_a?(String) && key.to_s.match?(SENSITIVE_EXAMPLE_KEY_RE)
        value[key] = "<redacted>"
      elsif child.is_a?(String)
        value[key] = child.gsub(EMAIL_EXAMPLE_RE, "<EMAIL>")
      else
        redact_sensitive_examples!(child)
      end
    end
  when Array
    value.each_with_index do |child, index|
      if child.is_a?(String) && !value.frozen?
        value[index] = child.gsub(EMAIL_EXAMPLE_RE, "<EMAIL>")
      else
        redact_sensitive_examples!(child)
      end
    end
  end
end

def yaml_files(dir)
  return [] unless Dir.exist?(dir)

  Dir[File.join(dir, "*")].select { |path| path.match?(/\.(ya?ml)\z/i) }.sort
end

def load_yaml_file(path)
  YAML.load_file(path, aliases: true, permitted_classes: [Date, Time])
rescue ArgumentError
  YAML.load_file(path)
end

def source_manifest(root)
  path = File.join(root, "manifest.json")
  return nil unless File.exist?(path)

  manifest = JSON.parse(File.read(path))
  digest = Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest
  [path, manifest, digest]
end

def validate_source_manifest!(root)
  payload = source_manifest(root)
  return nil unless payload

  path, manifest, digest = payload
  errors = []
  Array(manifest["files"]).each do |entry|
    rel = entry["path"].to_s
    if rel.empty? || rel.start_with?("/") || rel.split("/").include?("..")
      errors << "invalid source manifest path #{rel.inspect}"
      next
    end
    file = File.join(root, rel)
    unless File.file?(file)
      errors << "source manifest missing #{rel}"
      next
    end
    size = File.size(file)
    sha = Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest
    errors << "source manifest size mismatch #{rel}" if entry["bytes"].to_i != size
    errors << "source manifest sha256 mismatch #{rel}" if entry["sha256"].to_s != sha
  end

  # Completeness (reverse) check: every consumed openapi fragment on disk must be
  # pinned in the manifest. The forward loop above only verifies LISTED files; it
  # never asserts that every consumed input is listed, so a new/edited fragment
  # could otherwise slip in unhashed (e.g. audit-log.yaml did). These globs mirror
  # the generator's own probe-fragment globs below.
  pinned = Array(manifest["files"]).map { |entry| entry["path"].to_s }
  ["clockify-api-probe-lab/openapi-fragments", "clockify-api-probe-lab/openapi-fragments-v3"].each do |dir|
    Dir[File.join(root, dir, "*.yaml")].sort.each do |abs|
      rel = abs.sub(%r{\A#{Regexp.escape(root)}/?}, "")
      errors << "source consumed but not pinned in manifest: #{rel}" unless pinned.include?(rel)
    end
  end
  abort(errors.join("\n")) unless errors.empty?

  {
    "path" => path.sub(%r{\A#{Regexp.escape(root)}/?}, ""),
    "sha256" => digest,
    "files" => Array(manifest["files"]).size
  }
end

def source_label(path, options)
  expanded = File.expand_path(path)
  roots = {
    "realOPENAPI" => File.expand_path(options[:real_dir]),
    "clockify-api-probe-lab" => File.expand_path(options[:probe_dir]),
    "AIII" => File.dirname(File.expand_path(options[:aiii_openapi])),
    "GOCLMCP" => File.expand_path(options[:repo_root])
  }
  roots["qa-findings"] = File.expand_path(options[:findings_dir]) if options[:findings_dir].to_s != ""
  root_name, root_path = roots.find { |_name, root| expanded.start_with?(root + File::SEPARATOR) || expanded == root }
  return expanded unless root_name

  rel = expanded.sub(root_path, "").sub(%r{\A/}, "")
  rel.empty? ? root_name : File.join(root_name, rel)
end

def normalize_path(path)
  normalized = path.to_s.strip
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://auditlog-api\.api\.clockify\.me/api/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://auditlog-api\.api\.clockify\.me/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://api\.clockify\.me/api/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://reports\.api\.clockify\.me/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://api\.clockify\.me/api}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\Ahttps://reports\.api\.clockify\.me}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\A/api/v1}, "")
  normalized = normalized.sub(%r{\A/v1}, "")
  normalized = "/" + normalized unless normalized.start_with?("/")
  canonicalize_path_params(normalized.gsub(%r{/+}, "/"))
end

def canonicalize_path_params(path)
  segments = path.split("/")
  segments.each_with_index do |segment, i|
    next unless segment.match?(/\A\{[^}]+\}\z/)

    raw_name = segment[1..-2]
    previous = segments[i - 1].to_s
    canonical = case raw_name
                when "ws", "wsId", "workspace", "workspace_id", "workspaceId"
                  "workspaceId"
                when "uid", "user", "user_id", "userId"
                  "userId"
                else
                  canonical_param_for_segment(previous, raw_name)
                end
    segments[i] = "{#{canonical}}"
  end
  out = segments.join("/")
  out.empty? ? "/" : out
end

def host_for(path, op = nil, source_servers = [])
  text = [path, op&.fetch("description", nil), op&.fetch("summary", nil)].compact.join(" ").downcase
  operation_servers = Array(op && op["servers"]).map { |server| server["url"].to_s }
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if operation_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") }
  return REPORTS_SERVER if operation_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("reports.api.clockify.me") } &&
                           operation_servers.none? { |url| url.include?("api.clockify.me/api") }
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if source_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") }
  return REPORTS_SERVER if source_servers.any? { |url| url.include?("reports.api.clockify.me") } &&
                           source_servers.none? { |url| url.include?("api.clockify.me/api") }
  return AUDIT_LOG_SERVER if text.include?("auditlog-api.api.clockify.me") || text.include?("/audit-log")
  return REPORTS_SERVER if text.include?("/reports/") || text.include?("shared-reports")

  MAIN_SERVER
end

def normalize_security!(value, aliases)
  case value
  when Hash
    value.keys.each do |key|
      new_key = case key.to_s
                when "AddonKeyAuth", "MarketplaceKeyAuth"
                  aliases << key.to_s
                  "AddonTokenAuth"
                when "ApiKeyAuth"
                  "ApiKeyAuth"
                else
                  key
                end
      child = value.delete(key)
      value[new_key] = child
      normalize_security!(child, aliases)
    end
  when Array
    value.each { |item| normalize_security!(item, aliases) }
  end
end

def canonical_security_scheme(name)
  case name.to_s
  when "AddonKeyAuth", "MarketplaceKeyAuth", "AddonTokenAuth"
    "AddonTokenAuth"
  when "ApiKeyAuth"
    "ApiKeyAuth"
  else
    name.to_s
  end
end

def operation_security_aliases(op, schemes)
  aliases = Hash.new { |h, key| h[key] = {"schemes" => Set.new, "headers" => Set.new} }
  Array(op["security"]).each do |requirement|
    next unless requirement.is_a?(Hash)

    requirement.keys.each do |scheme|
      canonical = canonical_security_scheme(scheme)
      aliases[canonical]["schemes"] << scheme.to_s
      header = schemes.dig(scheme, "name").to_s if schemes.is_a?(Hash)
      aliases[canonical]["headers"] << header unless header.to_s.empty?
    end
  end
  aliases.keys.sort.each_with_object({}) do |scheme, out|
    out[scheme] = {
      "schemes" => aliases[scheme]["schemes"].to_a.sort,
      "headers" => aliases[scheme]["headers"].to_a.sort
    }
  end
end

def rewrite_refs!(value, ref_maps)
  case value
  when Hash
    if value["$ref"].is_a?(String)
      value["$ref"] = rewrite_ref(value["$ref"], ref_maps)
    end
    value.each_value { |child| rewrite_refs!(child, ref_maps) }
  when Array
    value.each { |child| rewrite_refs!(child, ref_maps) }
  end
end

def rewrite_ref(ref, ref_maps)
  match = ref.match(%r{\A#/components/([^/]+)/([^/]+)\z})
  return ref unless match

  section = match[1]
  name = match[2]
  mapped = ref_maps.dig(section, name)
  mapped ? "#/components/#{section}/#{mapped}" : ref
end

def operation_id(method, path, used)
  raw = "#{method}_#{path}"
        .gsub(/[{}]/, "")
        .gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/, "_")
        .gsub(/\A_+|_+\z/, "")
  parts = raw.split("_").reject(&:empty?)
  id = parts.first.to_s.downcase + parts.drop(1).map { |part| part[0].upcase + part[1..] }.join
  id = "#{method}Operation" if id.empty?
  unique = id
  suffix = 2
  while used.include?(unique)
    unique = "#{id}#{suffix}"
    suffix += 1
  end
  used << unique
  unique
end

def method_path_from_doc(lines)
  operations = []
  pending_method = nil
  lines.each do |line|
    stripped = line.strip
    if stripped.match?(/\A(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\z/i)
      pending_method = stripped.downcase
      next
    end
    inline = stripped.match(/\A(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)\s+(\/(?:api\/)?v1\/\S+)/i)
    if inline
      operations << [inline[1].downcase, normalize_path(inline[2])]
      pending_method = nil
      next
    end
    next unless pending_method && stripped.match?(%r{\A/(?:api/)?v1/})

    path = stripped.split(/\s+/).first
    operations << [pending_method, normalize_path(path)]
    pending_method = nil
  end
  operations.uniq
end

def status_bucket(status, text)
  lowered = text.to_s.downcase
  return "live-success" if status && status >= 200 && status < 300
  # 405 means the path EXISTS and the verb does not. Clockify returns
  # code:3000 for this as well as for an absent path, so bucket 405
  # separately before the absent-path test below; otherwise a live route
  # documented under the wrong verb reads as a phantom and invites a
  # wrong PHANTOM_PATHS entry. The distinguishing wire signal is the
  # `allow` response header, which lists the verbs the path does serve.
  return "method-not-allowed" if status == 405
  # 4xx with the "No static resource" upstream message means the path
  # itself does not exist. Match the MESSAGE, not the bare code:3000,
  # which Clockify reuses for wrong-verb responses. Treat as fully
  # unsupported / phantom so callers can decide to quarantine the path.
  # The /cap/ keyword used to match /scheduling/capacity by accident —
  # narrow it to whole words.
  return "unsupported" if status && [400, 404, 409, 415, 422].include?(status) &&
                          lowered.match?(/no static resource/)
  return "workspace-state-limited" if lowered.match?(/archive|active|workspace-state|in-use|\bcap-skipped\b|\bcap\s|\blimit\b/)
  return "permission-gated" if lowered.match?(/permission|plan|membership|owner|forbidden|not allowed|requires/)
  return "unsupported" if status && [400, 404, 405, 409, 415, 422].include?(status)
  return "documented" unless status

  "live-validated-error"
end

end

## Client/project archive update shape split — investigation

### `fern.sdk.clients-update-body-vs-projects-update-top-level` — DOCUMENTED 2026-05-26

- **Official claim:** the generated SDK exposes different request
  shapes for similar-looking update calls:
  `clients.update({ workspaceId, clientId, body })` and
  `projects.update({ workspaceId, projectId, ...fields })`.

- **Actual behaviour (live probe, 2026-05-26, sandbox workspace
  `<REDACTED_WORKSPACE_ID>`):** Clockify accepts client archive
  updates only with the nested client body shape
  (`body: { name, archived: true }`). Sending client update fields
  at the top level returns "Required request body is missing".
  Project archive updates, by contrast, accept the generated
  top-level project fields (`{ name, archived: true }`) and do not
  use a nested `body` wrapper in the generated SDK surface. The
  `archive` helper routes for both clients and projects returned
  404 in this live cleanup path, so archive+delete cleanup must use
  the update methods first.

- **Live evidence:**
  - `mcp/tests/server.test.ts` pins both generated SDK request
    shapes: project update fields at the request top level, client
    update fields inside `body`.
  - `mcp/tests/sandbox.test.ts` and `mcp/src/tools/workflows.ts`
    use the split during live cleanup.
  - 2026-05-26 final sandbox cleanup archived and deleted
    deterministic `DEMO-` projects with project top-level update,
    and deterministic `DEMO-` clients with nested client body
    update, then scanned clients/projects/tags/entries/invoices/
    webhooks to empty arrays for the deterministic prefixes.

- **MCP tools affected:**
  - `clockify_clients_update`
  - `clockify_projects_update`
  - `clockify_demo_cleanup`
  - live sandbox cleanup helpers in `mcp/tests/sandbox.test.ts`

- **Open questions:** whether future Fern versions can normalize
  generated update request shapes without breaking runtime
  behaviour. Until then, do not hand-normalize these two MCP paths.

- **Status:** accepted local SDK shape split. Keep client update
  fields nested under `body`; keep project update fields at the
  request top level. Re-test with live archive+delete cleanup before
  changing either shape.

## Name reserved after archive-then-delete (cross-repo: ai-assistant-addon)

### `entity.name-reserved-after-delete.cross-repo-2026-06-09` — DOCUMENTED 2026-06-09

- **Official claim:** none. The spec describes create
  (`POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects`, `.../tags`,
  `.../clients`) as taking a workspace-unique `name`, but says
  nothing about a name's lifecycle after the entity is deleted.
- **Actual behavior:** a project / tag / client NAME stays
  reserved even after the entity is archived and then deleted.
  Re-creating with the same name returns `... with this name
  already exists` (e.g. `"Project with this name already exists"`)
  even though the name no longer appears in any list — so a
  "list, then reuse the name" recovery never surfaces it. The only
  fix is a distinct name.
- **Live evidence:** discovered live in the sibling
  `../ai-assistant-addon` Clockify work — its live exerciser had to
  switch to unique `AIASSIST_SMOKE_*` names because archived-then-
  deleted names stayed taken (recorded in that repo's `CLAUDE.md`
  planner-quirks section). The conflict wire message is pinned by
  `../GOCLMCP/internal/clockify/errors_test.go`
  (`{"message":"Project with this name already exists","code":501}`).
- **MCP tools affected:** `clockify_projects_create`,
  `clockify_tags_create`, `clockify_clients_create`, and the
  generated SDK `projects.create` / `tags.create` / `clients.create`.
  GOCLMCP now emits a name-reservation recovery hint for these (its
  `internal/tools/firstslice_recovery.go` `recoverable(...)`
  "already exists" branch, with `recovery_test.go` coverage). The
  TS MCP/SDK do not yet surface this.
- **Open questions:** does Clockify ever release a reserved name
  (TTL, or only on workspace reset)? Does the reservation apply to
  tasks (per-project) the same way? Unprobed.
- **Status:** `documented; ts-side-hint-pending`. Recommend the TS
  MCP `clockify_*_create` tools (and the SDK `create` docstrings)
  warn that a previously deleted name may report "already exists"
  and to retry with a distinct name. No spec change — a platform
  behavior, not a shape divergence.

## Per-op host vs client `environment`/`baseUrl` override (add-on consumers)

### `config.per-op-host-vs-environment-override.cross-repo-2026-06-09` — DOCUMENTED 2026-06-09

- **Official claim:** n/a (SDK-internal). Reports run on
  `reports.api.clockify.me/v1` and audit on
  `auditlog-api.api.clockify.me/v1`; the corrected OpenAPI carries
  per-operation `servers` and the generator emits
  `OperationSpec.baseUrl`, so typed methods reach the right host.
- **Actual behavior (by design):** the generated `core/request.ts`
  resolves
  `clientOptions.baseUrl ?? clientOptions.environment ?? operation.baseUrl ?? Default`
  (emitter: `scripts/generate-sdk-from-openapi.mjs`
  `requestRuntimeSourceWithTimeoutAndRetry`). A client-level
  `baseUrl`/`environment` override therefore **wins over** the
  per-op reports/audit host. This is INTENTIONAL per
  `docs/config-precedence-policy.md` ("Base URL override rule":
  `environment`/`baseUrl` are mock/replay/private-gateway levers) —
  it lets one mock host capture ALL traffic, including reports/
  audit (`wrapper/tests/mock-clockify.test.ts` points `environment`
  at a localhost mock). Reordering `operation.baseUrl` ahead of
  `environment` would let reports/audit escape the mock and break
  replay.
- **Cross-repo observation:** the sibling `../ai-assistant-addon`
  is a Clockify ADD-ON whose API host is dynamic per install (read
  from the install-context `apiUrl`), and which derives the reports
  host from the `reportsUrl` claim and the audit host prod-only.
  That "set the api host AND keep per-op reports/audit hosts"
  pattern is NOT expressible through this SDK's single `environment`
  override (setting it clobbers the per-op hosts). A first-pass
  cross-repo audit flagged this precedence as a "bug"; it is not —
  it is the documented mock/replay contract.
- **MCP tools affected:** none directly. Affects SDK consumers that
  are themselves multi-host add-ons.
- **Open questions:** if add-on consumption (dynamic api host +
  derived reports/audit) becomes in-scope, the precedence reorder
  is the wrong fix; the right shape is a separate, explicit
  per-host override map (e.g. `hosts: {api, reports, audit}`) that
  leaves the single mock/replay override semantics intact. Out of
  scope until an add-on consumer is a real target.
- **Status:** `not-a-bug; intentional`. Recorded so a future audit
  does not "fix" the precedence and regress mock/replay. No code
  change.

  read-back. The wire scale matches addon `src/clockify/rest/invoices.ts:83`

  kept as corroboration only. **In-repo source of record:** committed redacted
  golden `spec/evidence/fixtures/invoice-item.unitprice.json` (`unitPrice:
  10000000`), replayed offline by `make replay-fixtures` asserting
  `invoiceItemUnitPriceFromWire(10000000) === 100000`, plus the unit pin
  `wrapper/tests/wire-shape.test.ts`. Ledgered in `docs/live-probe-ledger.json`.

  invoice item-add tool and no payment-create tool — the 8 invoices tools are

  returns `InvoicePaymentDto[]`. The two shapes are distinguished correctly, so
  there is no response-schema mistyping to fix in GOCLMCP and no SDK return-type bug.

  253-266, `deleteInvoicePayment` 268-270, `mapPayment` 100-116) + the
  `clockify-api-probe-lab` invoices fixtures (`05-payment-add-valid.json` is a
  full invoice doc; `05-payment-add-invalid.json` shows `paymentDate` is
  wire-required), plus the corrected spec + GOCLMCP canonical both binding 201 to
  `InvoiceDtoFull`. No fresh live mutation was run: re-confirming an already-typed,
  addon-attested shape adds residue risk (a post-payment PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID
  invoice has no proven direct DELETE path, and `deleteInvoicePayment` is itself
  `probe-documented`, not `live-success`) for no new information.

  `invoicePayments` resource is publicly surfaced via `ws.invoicePayments` +
  `iterAll(list)`, but only the read path.)

  an amount or a concurrent writer adds one; a future payment-create tool must
  require exactly one new id or report the recovery inconclusive.

  per-request status enum. Guarded 2026-06-18: `clockify_time_off_requests_list`'s
  `statuses` input enum is `REQUEST_SEARCH_STATUSES` = [ALL, PENDING, APPROVED,
  REJECTED], so `WITHDRAWN` is rejected at the input layer before the wire. Test:
  `mcp/tests/time-off-search-statuses.test.ts`.

- **Status:** `compensated-in-tool-layer` (2026-06-15). The tool now searches
  `timeOff.list` with `statuses:["ALL"]`, walks pages (bounded at 50×200), and
  scans by id; errors clearly when the id isn't in the search. Verified live

## Findings from the unproven-operation existence sweep (2026-07-28)

Method: every `probe-documented` / `documented` operation was issued against the
sacrificial sandbox with **fake 24-hex path ids** (`ffffffffffffffffffffffff`), so
no real entity was addressable and no mutation occurred. Control `GET /user` → 200.
`POST` operations were excluded (a fake id does not prevent a create), as were two
id-less writes (`publishAssignments`, `patchWorkspacesWorkspaceIdTimeEntriesInvoicedBulk`)
that could touch real state. 20 of 34 operations were probed.

The discriminator is Clockify's own 404 body: `"No static resource …", "code":3000`
means the *path* is not served, whereas any other 4xx means the route exists and only
the fake id was rejected.

### `archive-subpaths.projects-clients.phantom` — CONFIRMED 2026-07-28 (live)

- **Official claim:** `spec/corrected/clockify.corrected.openapi.yaml` ships
  `putWorkspacesWorkspaceIdProjectsProjectIdArchive`
  (`PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/archive`) and
  `putWorkspacesWorkspaceIdClientsClientIdArchive`
  (`PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients/{clientId}/archive`), both
  `x-clockify-live-status: probe-documented`.
- **Actual behavior:** both return **404** with
  `{"message":"No static resource v1/workspaces/{ws}/projects/{id}/archive.","code":3000}`
  (and the `clients` analogue). The `/archive` sub-path is not served under `PUT`.
- **Why this entry exists:** `deletes.archive-first.projects-tasks` records
  `POST /projects/{id}/archive` → 404 and calls the archive route dead. That evidence
  did **not** transfer — the shipped operations are a different method *and* a
  different path shape, so they sat in the 169 denominator on an untested assumption.
  Probing settles it: the `PUT` form is absent too.
- **MCP tools affected:** none in *this* repo — `x-clockify-mcp-tools: []` for both,
  and no `cli/src` or `mcp/src` source references either operationId. Archiving is
  done through the update body envelope (see `deletes.archive-first.*`), which is
  unaffected. **But the Go MCP in `../GOCLMCP` binds `clockify_projects_archive` to
  the phantom `PUT …/projects/{projectId}/archive`**, so that tool calls a route
  that always 404s. Surfaced by the `goMcpExact` coverage drop (82 -> 80) when the
  quarantine landed. Routed to GOCLMCP; not fixed here.
- **Open questions:** none for existence. Whether Clockify ever served these
  sub-paths historically is unknown and not worth establishing.
- **Status/resolution:** `phantom-confirmed`. Both belong in `PHANTOM_PATHS` in
  `../GOCLMCP/scripts/gen-clockify-openapi`, which removes them from the merged
  contract and therefore from the operation total.

### `time-off.requests.by-id.family-phantom` — CONFIRMED 2026-07-28 (live)

- **Official claim:** three operations hang off
  `/workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/requests/{requestId}`.
- **Actual behavior:** the whole by-id branch under `/time-off/requests/` is unserved.
  Each of the three returns **404** with `No static resource` / `code:3000`:

    (`GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/requests/{requestId}`) — 404,
    `No static resource`, phantom.
  - `deleteWorkspacesWorkspaceIdTimeOffRequestsRequestId`
    (`DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/requests/{requestId}`) — 404,
    `No static resource`, phantom.
  - `patchWorkspacesWorkspaceIdTimeOffRequestsRequestIdStatus`
    (`PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/requests/{requestId}/status`) — 404,
    `No static resource`, phantom.
- **Distinguish from the route that does exist:** `changeTimeOffRequestStatus` is
  `PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/policies/{policyId}/requests/{requestId}`
  — a *policy-scoped* path. It probes **400** (route exists, fake id rejected), so it
  is promotable, not phantom. The two must not be conflated.
- **Relation to the existing quarantine:** `spec/corrected/…yaml:23834` already
  quarantines the **collection** `GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-off/requests`.
  These three are the **by-id** siblings and are not covered by that entry.
- **MCP tools affected:** none in *this* repo (`x-clockify-mcp-tools: []` for all
  three). **The Go MCP in `../GOCLMCP` binds `clockify_time_off_requests_update` to
  the phantom `PATCH …/time-off/requests/{requestId}/status`**, so that tool calls a
  route that always 404s; the live path is the policy-scoped
  `changeTimeOffRequestStatus`. Surfaced by the `goMcpExact` coverage drop when the

- **Open questions:** this removes any API path for reading or deleting a single

  terminal (no API delete path)" is now explained rather than merely observed:
  there is no by-id delete route at all.
- **Status/resolution:** `phantom-confirmed`; all three belong in `PHANTOM_PATHS`.

"/workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects":
    get:
      tags:
      - Projects
      summary: Get all projects on a workspace
      operationId: getWorkspaceProjects
      security:
      - ApiKeyAuth: []
      - AddonTokenAuth: []
      parameters:
      - description: Represents a workspace identifier across the system.
        example: 64a687e29ae1f428e7ebe303
        in: path
        name: workspaceId
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
      - description: If provided, returns projects whose name contains the provided
          string.
        example: Software Development
        in: query
        name: name
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
      - description: When true, search by name returns only projects whose name exactly
          matches the name parameter.
        example: false
        in: query
        name: strict-name-search
        required: false
        schema:
          default: false
          type: boolean
      - description: If true, returns only archived projects. If omitted, returns
          both archived and non-archived projects.
        example: false
        in: query
        name: archived
        required: false
        schema:
          default: false
          type: boolean
      - description: If true, returns only billable projects. If omitted, returns
          both billable and non-billable projects.
        example: false
        in: query
        name: billable
        required: false
        schema:
          default: false
          type: boolean
      - description: If provided, returns projects that contain clients matching any
          provided ids.
        example:
        - 5a0ab5acb07987125438b60f
        - 64c777ddd3fcab07cfbb210c
        explode: true
        in: query
        name: clients
        required: false
        schema:
          items:
            type: string
          type: array
          uniqueItems: true
        style: form
      - description: Controls whether the clients filter includes or excludes matching
          client ids.
        example: true
        in: query
        name: contains-client
        required: false
        schema:
          default: true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared helpers for the Projects/Clients/Tasks/CustomFields/UserGroups/Tags audit.
# Sourced by probe scripts. Never echoes the API key.
source /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/env.sh

API="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1"
WS="65b382b606de527a7ee2b60e"
OUT=/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/live-results
mkdir -p "$OUT"

# req <label> <method> <path> [data] [extra-curl-args...]
# Captures status + headers + body. Prints one-line summary.
req() {
  local label="$1" method="$2" path="$3" data="$4"; shift 4
  local bodyfile="$OUT/$label.body.json"
  local hdrfile="$OUT/$label.hdr.txt"
  local args=(-sS -m 45 -X "$method" -H "X-Api-Key: $CLOCKIFY_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    args+=(-d "$data")
  fi
  args+=("$@" -D "$hdrfile" -o "$bodyfile" -w "%{http_code}" "$API$path")
  local code
  code=$(curl "${args[@]}")
  local allow
  allow=$(grep -i '^allow:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2-)
  local lp
  lp=$(grep -i '^last-page:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2-)
  local body
  body=$(head -c 400 "$bodyfile" | tr '\n' ' ')
  echo "[$label] $method $path -> HTTP $code | allow=$allow | last-page=$lp | body: $body"
}

# req-nobody: like req but body discarded to keep output small (still saved)
reqnb() {
  local label="$1" method="$2" path="$3" data="$4"; shift 4
  req "$label" "$method" "$path" "$data" "$@"
}

json_get() { # json_get <file> <key>
  python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('$1')); print(d.get('$2',''))" 2>/dev/null
}

#!/bin/bash
# Redacted probe library. Sources env.sh; NEVER prints the API key.
set -u
source /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/env.sh
WS="$CLOCKIFY_WORKSPACE_ID"
BASE="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1"

# probe METHOD PATH [--data JSON] [--data-file FILE] [--out NAME]
probe() {
  local method="$1"; local path="$2"; shift 2
  local data=() out="probe-$(date +%s)-$RANDOM"
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --data) data=(--data "$2"); shift 2;;
      --data-file) data=(--data-binary @"$2"); shift 2;;
      --out) out="$2"; shift 2;;
      *) shift;;
    esac
  done
  local hdrfile="/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/probes/${out}.hdr"
  local bodyfile="/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/probes/${out}.json"
  local code
  code=$(curl -sS -o "$bodyfile" -D "$hdrfile" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$method" \
    -H "X-Api-Key: $CLOCKIFY_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    "${data[@]+"${data[@]}"}" "$BASE$path")
  # header summary (strip any auth echoes just in case)
  local lastpage headers
  lastpage=$(grep -i '^last-page:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ast-[Pp]age: //' | head -1)
  headers=$(grep -iE '^(last-page|content-type|allow):' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ';')
  echo "== $method $path -> HTTP $code | last-page=${lastpage:-<absent>}"
  echo "   headers: $headers"
  echo "   body bytes: $(wc -c < "$bodyfile" | tr -d ' ')"
  echo "$code $method $path last-page=${lastpage:-<absent>}" >> /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/probes/summary.txt
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared helpers for the Projects/Clients/Tasks/CustomFields/UserGroups/Tags audit (group: projects-clients-tasks).
# Sources env.sh; NEVER echoes the API key.
source /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/env.sh

API="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1"
WS="65b382b606de527a7ee2b60e"
OUT=/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/live-results-pct
mkdir -p "$OUT"

# req <label> <method> <path> [data] [extra-curl-args...]
# Captures status + headers + body. Prints one-line summary.
req() {
  local label="$1" method="$2" path="$3" data="$4"
  shift 4 2>/dev/null || shift "${#@}"
  local bodyfile="$OUT/$label.body.json"
  local hdrfile="$OUT/$label.hdr.txt"
  local args=(-sS -m 45 -X "$method" -H "X-Api-Key: $CLOCKIFY_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    args+=(-d "$data")
  fi
  args+=("$@" -D "$hdrfile" -o "$bodyfile" -w "%{http_code}")
  local code
  code=$(curl "${args[@]}")
  local allow lastpage
  allow=$(grep -i '^allow:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2-)
  lastpage=$(grep -i '^last-page:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2-)
  local body
  body=$(head -c 500 "$bodyfile" | tr '\n' ' ')
  echo "[$label] $method $path -> HTTP $code | allow=${allow:-<none>} | last-page=${lastpage:-<absent>} | body: $body"
}

json_get() { # json_get <file> <key>
  python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('$1')); print(d.get('$2',''))" 2>/dev/null
}

source /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/env.sh

API="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1"
WS="65b382b606de527a7ee2b60e"
OUT=/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/live-results-pct
mkdir -p "$OUT"

# req <label> <method> <path> [data] [extra-curl-args...]
# Captures status + headers + body. Prints one-line summary.
req() {
  local label="$1" method="$2" path="$3" data="$4"
  shift 4 2>/dev/null || shift "${#@}"
  local bodyfile="$OUT/$label.body.json"
  local hdrfile="$OUT/$label.hdr.txt"
  local args=(-sS -m 45 -X "$method" -H "X-Api-Key: $CLOCKIFY_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json")
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    args+=(-d "$data")
  fi
  args+=("$@" -D "$hdrfile" -o "$bodyfile" -w "%{http_code}")
  local code
  code=$(curl "${args[@]}")
  local allow lastpage
  allow=$(grep -i '^allow:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2-)
  lastpage=$(grep -i '^last-page:' "$hdrfile" | tr -d '\r' | cut -d' ' -f2-)
  local body
  body=$(head -c 500 "$bodyfile" | tr '\n' ' ')
  echo "[$label] $method $path -> HTTP $code | allow=${allow:-<none>} | last-page=${lastpage:-<absent>} | body: $body"
}

json_get() { # json_get <file> <key>
  python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('$1')); print(d.get('$2',''))" 2>/dev/null
}
",
  "path": "/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/lib-pct.sh"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 3) Task lifecycle; 4) archive subpaths; 9) from-template
source /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/lib-pct.sh
TS=$(date +%s)
PNAME="DSAUDIT_TPROJ_${TS}"
TNAME="DSAUDIT_TASK_${TS}"

req t-proj-create POST "/workspaces/$WS/projects" "{\"name\":\"$PNAME\"}"
PID=$(json_get "$OUT/t-proj-create.body.json" id)
echo "project id: $PID"

echo "=== TASK LIFECYCLE ==="
req task1-create POST "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/tasks" "{\"name\":\"$TNAME\"}"
TID=$(json_get "$OUT/task1-create.body.json" id)
echo "task id: $TID"
echo "--- create body ---"; cat "$OUT/task1-create.body.json"; echo

req task2-delete-active DELETE "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/tasks/$TID"
echo "--- delete active task ---"; cat "$OUT/task2-delete-active.body.json"; echo

req task3-mark-done PUT "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/tasks/$TID" "{\"name\":\"$TNAME\",\"status\":\"DONE\"}"
echo "--- mark DONE body ---"; cat "$OUT/task3-mark-done.body.json"; echo

req task4-delete DELETE "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/tasks/$TID"
echo "--- delete DONE task ---"; cat "$OUT/task4-delete.body.json"; echo

req task5-get-after-delete GET "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/tasks/$TID"
echo "--- get after delete ---"; cat "$OUT/task5-get-after-delete.body.json"; echo

req task6-recreate POST "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/tasks" "{\"name\":\"$TNAME\"}"
echo "--- recreate same name ---"; cat "$OUT/task6-recreate.body.json"; echo

echo "=== ARCHIVE SUBPATHS (real id + fake id) ==="
req arch1-proj-real PUT "/workspaces/$WS/projects/$PID/archive" "{}"
req arch2-proj-fake PUT "/workspaces/$WS/projects/ffffffffffffffffffffffff/archive" "{}"
req arch3-client-real PUT "/workspaces/$WS/clients/6a762ac2a8059cd29d09ab92/archive" "{}"
req arch4-client-fake PUT "/workspaces/$WS/clients/ffffffffffffffffffffffff/archive" "{}"
echo "--- PUT projects/{real}/archive body ---"; cat "$OUT/arch1-proj-real.body.json"; echo
echo "--- PUT projects/{fake}/archive body ---"; cat "$OUT/arch2-proj-fake.body.json"; echo
echo "--- PUT clients/{real}/archive body ---"; cat "$OUT/arch3-client-real.body.json"; echo
echo "--- PUT clients/{fake}/archive body ---"; cat "$OUT/arch4-client-fake.body.json"; echo

echo "=== FROM-TEMPLATE (fake id; also check templates list) ==="
req tmpl1-list GET "/workspaces/$WS/projects?is-template=true"
echo "--- template count ---"; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$OUT/tmpl1-list.body.json'));print(len(d))" 2>/dev/null
req tmpl2-create-fake POST "/workspaces/$WS/projects/from-template" "{\"templateId\":\"ffffffffffffffffffffffff\",\"name\":\"DSAUDIT_TMPL_$TS\"}"
echo "--- from-template fake body ---"; cat "$OUT/tmpl2-create-fake.body.json"; echo

# Group Findings — Projects + Clients + Tasks + archive/delete lifecycle + custom fields + user groups + tags

- **Audit date:** 2026-08-07 (live re-probes against sacrificial sandbox `65b382b606de527a7ee2b60e`)
- **Group scope:** ledger entries `deletes.archive-first.*`, `archive-subpaths.projects-clients.phantom`, `project.update.omitted-field-semantics-unconfirmed`, `entity.name-reserved-after-delete.cross-repo-2026-06-09`, `clients.update.archived-missing-from-canonical-request`, `tasks.create.billable-missing-from-create-request`, `custom-fields.create.required-missing-from-request`, `fern.sdk.clients-update-body-vs-projects-update-top-level`, `user-groups.get.returns-void`, `single-gets.custom-field-get.dead-route`
- **Live evidence files:** raw bodies/headers under `/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/live-results-pct/` (probe scripts: `probe-client.sh`, `probe-project.sh`, `probe-task.sh`, `probe-cf.sh`, `probe-ug-tags.sh`, `probe-misc.sh`, `probe-cleanup.sh`, `lib-pct.sh`). API key redacted everywhere; never printed.
- **Leftovers:** 0 — final scan of projects/clients/tags/user-groups/custom-fields (incl. `archived=true`) shows no `DSAUDIT` entities. All created entities were archive-then-deleted (clients/projects) or directly deleted (tasks, tags, user-groups, custom-fields).
- **Workspace concurrency caveat:** the shared probe library path collided with another concurrent agent's file (same `/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/probe-lib.sh` name), so this group used unique `lib-pct.sh` / `live-results-pct/` names. One tag created by this group was already gone (400 "Tag doesn't belong to Workspace") when this group's cleanup DELETE ran — consistent with a concurrent agent's DSAUDIT sweep. Net leftovers still 0.

## Entry 1 — `deletes.archive-first` (~2406) + `deletes.archive-first.projects-tasks` (~2459) + `deletes.archive-first.clients-blocked` (~2482)

| field | value |
|---|---|

| **Status** | CONFIRMED-STILL-HOLDS (re-verified live 2026-08-07) |
| **Corrected judgment** | Correct — archive-before-delete is real; tool-layer compensation (GET-then-PUT archive/DONE, then DELETE) is the right design. No spec shape change needed. |
| **Official judgment** | Official spec documents DELETE → 200 without documenting the active-entity rejection; same gap as corrected. Not a spec divergence — a platform behavior both specs omit. |
| **Confidence** | high (all three entities probed through full lifecycle) |
| **Severity** | info (behavior confirmed; nothing to fix) |
| **Live probe record** | Client: `DELETE /clients/{active}` → **400** `{"message":"Cannot delete an active client","code":501}`; `PUT /clients/{id}` `{name, archived:true}` → **200** (archived:true; email+note reset to null — replace semantics); `DELETE` → **200** returning the deleted client object. Project: `DELETE /projects/{active}` → **400** `{"message":"Cannot delete an active project","code":501}`; archive PUT → 200; `DELETE` → 200 returning the project object. Task: `DELETE /tasks/{active}` → **400** `{"message":"Cannot delete an active task","code":501}`; `PUT {name, status:"DONE"}` → 200; `DELETE` → 200 returning the task object. |
| **Recommended action** | Keep ledger entry as-is. No spec change. |
